description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the WorkScheduleService component within the OrangeHRM Leave module. It tests various scenarios regarding the retrieval and validation of work schedule implementations, including handling of invalid classes, exceptions during instantiation, and ensuring the correct class is used.

classes.name: WorkScheduleServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing the WorkScheduleService's ability to retrieve, validate, and instantiate correct work schedule classes, including handling errors and misconfigurations.

classes.name: TestWorkScheduleInvalidClass
classes.description: A dummy class representing an invalid work schedule implementation for testing class interface validation.

classes.name: TestWorkScheduleInvalidClassExceptionInConstructor
classes.description: A dummy class that throws an exception during construction to test error handling when instantiating work schedule classes.

classes.name: TestWorkScheduleValidClass
classes.description: A mock implementation of the WorkScheduleInterface used for testing the successful retrieval and instantiation of a valid work schedule class.

methods.name: testGetWorkScheduleNotDefined
methods.description: Tests behavior when the work schedule implementation is not defined (null).

methods.name: testGetWorkScheduleClassNotFound
methods.description: Tests behavior when the specified work schedule class does not exist.

methods.name: testGetWorkScheduleInvalidClass
methods.description: Tests behavior when the specified class does not implement the proper interface.

methods.name: testGetWorkScheduleClassExceptionInConstructor
methods.description: Tests behavior when instantiation of the work schedule class throws an exception.

methods.name: testGetWorkSchedule
methods.description: Tests the successful retrieval and validation of a correct work schedule class.
